find: fillStockCueEntry(span, `P${entry.slot + 1}${teamMark} `, entry, row, running, now, stocks.length);
replace: fillStockCueEntry(span, `P${entry.slot + 1}${row === 'marks' ? '' : teamMark} `, entry, row, running, now, stocks.length);
why: The Teams strip drops its letter once it draws marks (issue #1128), the reading that the shape replaces the letter. The ruling keeps both: the shape says which player, and the letter and the color say which side, so a color-blind reader, a forced-colors palette and a greyscale screenshot lose the side with the letter gone. `stock-chip-drops-the-team-letter` cannot see it: its case mounts a HUD with no marker, which draws pips and keeps the letter here.
